hp_recovery.source: ActionResolution.c original146C.c:12862 and Items/Recovery.c original146C.c:12109; US module mediator/stat-calculator tables verified locally.

controls.Circle: Draw the equipped weapon from idle field; otherwise open attack targeting or confirm a target. Do not send ordinary confirms during an active timing window.
controls.Cross: Interact with a nearby authored door or cancel a targeting/menu screen.
controls.Triangle: Open the ordinary menu from idle field.
controls.Square: A normal field jump with held direction when native movement flags permit it; otherwise only its equipped reaction slot. Never use it as an arbitrary menu confirm.
controls.movement: World positions and camera yaw are authoritative. Movement must use normal directional buttons, never write position.

combat: Non-player actors are not automatically enemies. Props and friendly actors can have HP; use native hostility or an active incoming attack.
Weapon range is a native shape descriptor, not a guessed universal sphere. Native target previews decide whether a body part can actually be selected.
Do not replace an unavailable native fact with a plausible value.
Use the currently equipped weapon and learned actions. Do not grant equipment, HP, MP, flags or skills.
Changing HP through ordinary attacks or equipped abilities is an observed outcome, not a controller state edit.
Historical outcomes are evidence with their original context, not guaranteed predictions for another enemy, weapon or room.
A passed physical traversal is not proof that every observed enemy died. Read the coverage and observed-death counts; an older outcome without a coverage label does not establish a combat victory.
An observed spell_action_ids list is evidence that this actor has native spell actions. Unknown capabilities are not proof that it is not a caster.

Against a caster, consider Silence or intelligence reduction if learned, affordable, in range and not blocked by status immunity; verify application and do not repeatedly waste MP on an immune target.
Buff yourself appropriately before offense when it is safe and affordable. Existing statuses must not be blindly recast.
Heal before a dangerous HP deficit becomes fatal. Heal targets Ashley, consumes actual MP, and must be verified by native HP restoration rather than a menu-confirm acknowledgment.
Explore the currently learned action_options and actual mappings, not every possible action in the game. Map available chain/defense abilities through their normal menus.
A continuous offensive chain may kill a surviving boss after one opening attack, but this is a possible strategy, not a required outcome or immunity/resource guarantee.

23.name: Gain Life
23.effect: HP recovery from the executed chain

26.name: Raging Ache
26.effect: HP damage derived from Ashley's missing HP; no missing-HP component at full health.

27.name: Mind Ache
27.effect: MP damage derived from Ashley's missing MP; useless against a target with no MP.

28.name: Temper
28.effect: Damages the target and restores weapon DP, capped at its capacity.

29.name: Crimson Pain
29.effect: Additional target damage but also self HP damage; avoid when Ashley's health is unsafe.

30.name: Instill
30.effect: Target damage and equipped weapon PP restoration, capped normally.

31.name: Phantom Pain
31.effect: Converts equipped weapon PP into damage and drains that PP; do not assume PP exists.

40.name: Ward
40.effect: Cures paralysis and numbness only; does not negate an ordinary damaging attack.

41.name: Siphon Soul
41.effect: Restores 50 percent of incoming spell MP cost, bounded by missing MP; no nonspell benefit.

42.name: Reflect Magic
42.effect: Returns 40 percent of incoming damaging spell HP+MP amount to the source; does not cancel the original hit.

43.name: Reflect Damage
43.effect: Returns 40 percent of incoming damaging nonspell HP+MP amount to the source; does not cancel the original hit.

44.name: Absorb Magic
44.effect: Recovers 20 percent of matching incoming damaging spell HP+MP amount after the hit; not immunity.

45.name: Absorb Damage
45.effect: Recovers 20 percent of matching incoming damaging nonspell HP+MP amount after the hit; not immunity.

46.name: Impact Guard
46.effect: Recovers 50 percent of incoming damaging HP+MP amount only for physical affinity0.

47.name: Windbreak
47.effect: Recovers 50 percent only for matching air affinity1.

48.name: Fireproof
48.effect: Recovers 50 percent only for matching fire affinity2.

49.name: Terra Ward
49.effect: Recovers 50 percent only for matching earth affinity3.

50.name: Aqua Ward
50.effect: Recovers 50 percent only for matching water affinity4.

51.name: Shadow Guard
51.effect: Recovers 50 percent only for matching light affinity5.

52.name: Demonscale
52.effect: Recovers 50 percent only for matching dark affinity6.

53.name: Phantom Shield
53.effect: Converts current shield PP to recovery after damage and drains that PP; useless with zero PP.

semantics_provenance: Native action IDs/names/costs: SLUS_010.40 table0x3C1DC,52-byte stride. Status parameter indices: production StatusEffects.c mediators; resolve actual bitmasks from observed status_masks (the historical enum is not runtime-mask authority). Reflection/scaling: Damage.c11686/11703/12156/12191/12208 and ActionEffects.c12606 onward, verified by ability-effects tests. Menus filter current learned actions. Timing acceptance is not proof of useful effects.

reactions.success: The evaluated pre-increment timer must be strictly greater than abilityWindow and at most abilityWindow plus margin.
reactions.margin: Start at8 when story flag1 is set, otherwise10; incoming action IDs54+ add4. Subtract queueIndex/3 and clamp to at least2.
constraints: Use only currently mapped slots that the native eligibility query permits.
Do not repeat previousChainInput or a face button excluded by previousChainButtons.
One timing attempt per action; an early or late press is not a successful chain.
Successful chain and defense acknowledgments are native values1 and2 respectively.
The reactor, not model inference or a memorized absolute timeline, owns frame-sensitive input.
Do not invent an equipped ability effect from an undocumented numeric ID.

verification: A clean process exit is not proof of combat or a passed door.
Require actual native outcomes, and preserve failed or blocked observations.
Door acceptance still requires its original ready/event/control/transition predicates for120 native ticks.
Do not force scene completion, skip an event, modify story flags or fabricate actors.
Missed, rejected or unconfirmed eligible reactions must be reported, never counted as perfect.
